implemented_slice.change: Replaced immutable-identity-only activation assessment with fail-closed deployment context binding requiring expected Vercel project id, project name, and immutable GitHub repository id.

verification.method: Focused local Node reconstruction of the committed assessor contract and dependencies
limitations: The full repository test inventory was not executed because no authenticated checkout was available in the runtime.

No browser, mobile Safari, audio, or public route behavior was tested.
